title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan stew cooked in a clay pot, flavored with aromatic spices and served over warm couscous. This dish is a perfect example of Moroccan cuisine, where the slow-cooked meat is tender and falls apart easily.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern stores

instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a clay tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, spice blend, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve over warm couscous, garnished with parsley.
